$comment: Zero-prompt defaults. When the user supplies a design system and content but
no instructions -- no card count, no format, no tone, no taxonomy -- these are
the decisions taken WITHOUT asking. The point is that 'make me a library from
this' is a complete instruction: every field below has a defensible default,
so nothing blocks on a question whose answer is nearly always the same.
Anything the user DOES specify overrides the matching key.

layout.inputs: frozen copies of the design system and every source document
layout.dist: the deliverable bundle: .dc.html, runtime, canvas.html, slot state
layout.audit: scorecard, lint, measure, uniq, report.html, history.jsonl

project.rationale: A run is a project, not a directory. Writing every artifact into the current working directory means a second library built in the same folder silently overwrites the first, with no warning at any point. Create the project first; every stage after reads its wiring from project.json, which is also what lets audit take zero arguments instead of five paths that can each be wrong.

constraints.rationale: Any constraint the user states in prose becomes a field in the manifest and a code in the linter, or it is not a constraint. A rule only a careful human enforces is a rule that eventually gets skipped under deadline pressure and ships a regression nobody catches.
constraints.legal_fix_note: CROSS_REFERENCE is resolved by RESTATING the referenced fact on the card. Deleting the referring sentence leaves the card thinner than it was: a card that points elsewhere is a card missing content, which is the density law wearing a different hat.

preview.rationale: A .dc.html expects a host application to supply the canvas, the zoom and the prop editor; served from a plain static server it renders and does nothing, with no error message. scaffold init installs canvas.html into the bundle and the pipeline ends by opening it — a library nobody has looked at is not finished, and some compositional defects are invisible in every deterministic number and obvious the moment you actually see the card.

artboard.rationale: 3:4 is the format professional carousel libraries in this category use: taller than 4:5, so it carries more content per card while still cropping safely for Instagram portrait. Switch to 1080x1350 only when the user names Instagram specifically.

scale.rationale: Reference libraries run 40-120 formats. 50 is enough for the taxonomy to feel complete and the narrative arc to have room, and small enough to build carefully in one pass. Go to 100+ only when asked.

themes.rationale: One document, one enum prop, both themes applied at runtime by applyTheme(). Never emit separate light and dark files -- they drift apart immediately and double the maintenance surface.

surfaces.rationale: A named surface set is the single highest-leverage move for perceived range. Binary light/dark is the most common failure in generated libraries. Derive accent grounds from the brand's accent colour darkened to a usable ground if the source does not supply them.
surfaces.rule: Never place two cards with the same loud ground (ink, accent-1, accent-2) adjacent.

media.placeholder_style: describe the intended subject, never the word 'Image'
media.rationale: A library demoed with grey rectangles reads as unfinished regardless of layout quality. Prefill from openly-licensed sources; uniform grayscale makes heterogeneous stock look commissioned.

candidates: ornamental/swash capital opening display words at ~1.4x cap height
corner micro-labels pinned to artboard edges
a single geometric intervention repeated at varying scale (notch, cut corner, bleed)
a fixed rule weight used as the only divider
hanging index numbers in the left margin
grammar.rationale: Colours and fonts are not a grammar. Two or three arbitrary-but-relentlessly-consistent devices are what make a library read as authored. If the brand supplies none, invent one and apply it everywhere -- an invented device used fifty times reads as intent.

typography.rationale: Three registers max: display, body, micro. The micro register (corner labels, index numbers, credits, bracketed asides) is where density comes from without loudness. The 120px display floor and 52px headline floor are what dscc doctor enforces; both come from thumbnail legibility at 3.6x reduction.

taxonomy.naming: flat numbered list of specific named formats
taxonomy.rationale: If two format names could be swapped without anyone noticing, they are one format. A good name describes mechanic, content type and rough appearance.

structural_formats.rationale: Connective tissue appears as often as content in a real carousel and is usually the most typographically confident work in the set, because it has the least content and composition has nowhere to hide.

content.rationale: Extract 3x the card count in atomic claims. The surplus is what resolves under-written cards later without inventing anything.

forbidden: web chrome of any kind (buttons, nav, pricing tiers, forms, tabs)
lorem ipsum or placeholder category names
numbers absent from the source material

output.rationale: Every built library is a self-contained bundle and scripts/scaffold.py installs and verifies all of it on every build, so this is mechanical rather than remembered. The .dc.html is an OUTPUT: the generator beside it is the source. A 121 KB hand-edited HTML file with no source cannot be re-typed, re-themed or re-ordered; the same file with a 400-line builder is an asset.

builder_invariants: main() always re-scaffolds from scratch. Patching the document in place makes the style layer sticky — `if MARKER not in doc` is never true after the first successful build, so every later CSS edit silently does not reach the output, and the failure looks exactly like the edit not working.

Ground tokens go into :root BEFORE the CSS layer is inserted. Reversing the order and guarding the injection with `if '--tok' not in doc` matches the CSS layer's own var(--tok) uses, so the tokens are never written and the document fills with UNDECLARED_VAR P0s.

Never emit numeric HTML entities. `◇` survives tag-stripping in the auditor's text extractor as the digits 9671, which the veracity check reads as an invented figure. One decorative lozenge produced fifty P0s and a failed gate. Write the literal character; the document is UTF-8.
Every colour used in card markup belongs in BOTH theme maps. A token declared once in :root cannot follow the theme, so on a two-theme document it is provably wrong in one of them (MONO_THEME_TOKEN).
when_to_actually_ask: The source documents contradict each other on a fact that would appear on a card.
The brand supplies no colour information at all and no accent can be inferred.
The user's content is clearly for a medium other than social carousels (a report, a spec sheet).
Everything else: choose from this file and state the choice in the final report.
